title: 'Lion King' Panorama
notes: Context image, not taken at landing: shot as Opportunity left Eagle crater.
alt: Panorama of Eagle crater, a shallow bowl in reddish sand, with the empty lander at its centre and the rover's wheel tracks curving up the slope.

title: Discovery Served Up in a Bowl
alt: Close-up of a pale, cracked rock scattered with small dark spheres nicknamed blueberries, with a round lighter patch in the middle of the rock.

title: Looking Back at 'Purgatory Dune'
notes: Navcam image taken a week after the rover drove onto firmer ground.
alt: Black-and-white view back along two deep, churned wheel tracks leading away from the rover across rippled sand.

title: 'Victoria Crater' at Meridiani Planum
notes: Orbital image from HiRISE on Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter.
alt: Orbital view of Victoria crater, a scalloped bowl about 800 metres across with a field of dunes on its floor.

title: Arrival at 'Spirit Point' by Mars Rover Opportunity
notes: Panorama at the rim of Endeavour crater.
alt: Black-and-white panorama from the rim of Endeavour crater: a low rocky ridge in front, with the wide crater floor and distant rim beyond.

title: 'Esperance' Target Examined by Opportunity
notes: Pancam, false color; the area shown is about 70 cm across.
alt: False-color close-up of broken rock slabs, with a pale, light-toned vein of rock running across the middle.

title: Opportunity's Last Message
notes: Left Pancam with solar filter. Dust blocked the Sun; white specks are camera noise; the bottom is blank because the transmission was cut off.
alt: An almost black, speckled frame with no visible landscape; the lower part of the image is missing.

title: Opportunity's Final Traverse Map
notes: Background is three CTX images from Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter. Also used as the basemap via a 2-point fit.
alt: Orbital map of Meridiani Planum with Opportunity's route drawn from Eagle crater south-east to Endeavour crater.
